summary: Chanson International Holding disclosed results of its Class A EGM and EGM held on August 24, 2026. Shareholders approved a special resolution increasing Class B ordinary share voting rights from 50 to 80 votes per share (Class B Variation), an ordinary resolution authorizing share consolidations at a ratio between 2:1 and 250:1 over up to one year, with fractional shares rounded up, and adoption of amended articles reflecting these changes. The company also approved adjournment provisions. These governance and capital structure changes suggest restructuring of share capital and voting control, likely to affect shareholder rights and ownership dynamics. Watch for board execution of consolidation and potential impact on share price and liquidity.
